ModMetaData.name: Kreetle Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Kreetle art (adult south/east/north facings only - the juvenile "maggot" stage and the dessicated-corpse texture stay on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 sitting ruling: SW canon creature "redo" means full regeneration by gathered reference, never a rename. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Kreetle/Kreetle_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
UNVERIFIED as of authoring: the donor ships these textures inside a Unity AssetBundle (AssetBundles/, no loose Textures/swanimals/ folder at all), not as loose files. Loose-overrides-loose-by-load-order is proven elsewhere in this repo; loose-overrides-AssetBundle-by-load-order is NOT yet confirmed working for this donor - same open question as MynockArtOverride. Needs a live look (spawn/view a Kreetle in-game) before this mod is trusted.
